about.name: Anu Anand Annu
about.title: Software Engineer | Agentic AI & Full-Stack Developer
about.summary: Software Engineer with 2+ years building production Agentic AI systems at GEP Worldwide, processing thousands of global supplier records. Designed LangGraph multi-agent pipelines that cut onboarding from 12 days to 15 minutes and reduced manual effort by 90%. IIT Tirupati CS graduate with hands-on experience in RAG, Azure Document Intelligence, and LLM orchestration at enterprise scale. Seeking AI Engineer roles to architect intelligent automation systems at scale.

description: Architected a LangGraph-based multi-agent supplier onboarding platform with persistent memory, shared agent context, and real-time Brave Search integration - reducing onboarding time from 12 days to 15 minutes across 5,000+ global suppliers.

Built an end-to-end supplier automation pipeline for data auto-fill, multilingual document extraction, and sanctions/adverse-media screening - achieving 95% validation accuracy and eliminating 90% of manual effort across 5,000+ supplier records.

Designed and deployed an AI-powered Intelligent Document Processing (IDP) system using Azure Document Intelligence to parse PDFs, scanned documents, and structured forms with 96% extraction accuracy, significantly reducing manual data entry.
Developed a Supplier Assistant RAG agent integrating contextual supplier data and third-party APIs - reducing support dependency by ~60% through retrieval-augmented guidance and real-time assistance.
Led a 4-engineer team across sprint planning, release management, risk mitigation, and cross-functional delivery - achieving 100% on-time releases with zero production regressions.
Improved engineering productivity by 60% through AI-assisted development workflows, automation tooling, and internal enablement initiatives, accelerating feature delivery across teams.
Created technical documentation and conducted knowledge-transfer sessions to streamline AI adoption, onboarding, and team ramp-up.

Conducted R&D on translation/transliteration APIs; built optimized pipelines using Python multiprocessing and Azure Cognitive Services, automating multilingual workflows and reducing manual effort by ~90%.

projects.title: Deep RL for Automated Portfolio Management
projects.description: Deep reinforcement learning for optimized stock portfolio management strategies.
highlights: Implemented and benchmarked 6 deep reinforcement learning algorithms - PPO, A2C, DDPG, TD3, SAC, and a novel Average Reward TRPO - for stock portfolio management on DJIA and NIFTY 50 datasets.
Developed an Average Reward TRPO framework that outperformed all discounted-reward baseline models in cumulative return across multiple market environments.
Validated model performance through extensive back-testing and live paper trading using the Alpaca API.
